content.body:
This is the Battleground Europe Theater Map. From here you can see towns, roads, coastlines and other strategic information about the game world.
When playing offline, towns revert to their initial state and ownership. British towns are owned by the British, French towns are owned by the French, etc.
When playing online, the town ownerships change based on player actions. When you capture a building or even a whole town, its ownership reflected on the map.
The buttons on the left will show you additional information. Click a button again to hide that information.
content.title: Theater Map
